maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mostly recurring subscriptions to RingEX cloud phone, messaging, video and contact-center software, not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are over 600,000 private businesses of all sizes paying for communications subscriptions; government and education are minor segments.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its own cloud communications and AI platform; acquisitions are only occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Core business phone and contact-center system with 99.999% reliability; switching means migration, retraining, number porting and downtime risk.
